items.title: Waldren "Frog" Joseph Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: And then I went to Lesson at Pinchback Two-Role for a while

ctx.x: Well he died up north then. Yeah. I never did know him and I just wondered if he was still living someplace else, you know, or. Yeah.

And then I went to Lesson at Pinchback Two-Role for a while, but still playing in the school band, drum. Then after, I don't know what happened to Two-Role, but then I went to Lesson by Eddie Pearson.
